name: GOV.UK header
summary: Use the official GOV.UK header on authorised GOV.UK services to identify the site and link consistently to the GOV.UK homepage.
whenToUse: Use the official component for services that are part of GOV.UK and authorised to display its crown and logotype.
Pair it with Service navigation when the service needs a service name or service-level links.
whenNotToUse: Do not use the GOV.UK crown or logotype for a service outside the GOV.UK proposition or without identity approval.
Do not recreate, redraw or substitute the protected identity asset from these documentation records; use the official GOV.UK Frontend component and assets.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: The GOV.UK header component establishes the official site identity.

anatomy.name: Width container
anatomy.description: The inner content aligns with the page grid.

anatomy.name: GOV.UK homepage link
anatomy.description: The official crown and logotype link to the GOV.UK homepage with the supplied accessible name.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: The standard GOV.UK site identity above Service navigation or main content.

behaviour: The current GOV.UK header itself requires no component JavaScript; initialise any separate Service navigation beneath it.
Use the official template or macro so identity markup and assets stay aligned with the pinned GOV.UK Frontend release.
Do not inline an invented or extracted logo in framework adapters.
accessibility: Preserve the official accessible name, link semantics and focus treatment supplied by GOV.UK Frontend.
Keep the header readable at high zoom and do not place application content over the identity.
Avoid duplicate GOV.UK homepage links with the same accessible name in the header.
content: Do not alter the GOV.UK logotype text, crown or relationship between them.
Put the service name and service-level links in Service navigation, not inside a custom header imitation.
Follow the GOV.UK identity and domain guidance before publication.
